scope: Ordinary public Start and actual Reader advances/eligible choices, plus Story Review replay controls. No script loading, stage/voice injection, or engine-state mutation. A pre-page Web Audio observer mirrors final channel gain connections to the real AudioContext destination into a stereo AudioWorklet, retaining actual PCM and output clock mapping. Videos use actual CDP screenshots and that destination WAV; no dubbed source audio. The existing opt-in audioProbe observes the Reader audio owner independently.

actualAudio.source: actual AudioContext destination connections mirrored after their channel gains; exact chronological observed output blocks without interpolation or inserted samples

oracle.purpose: verification oracle only; never used as delivered video/audio

encoding.scope: Actual CDP screenshots at observed timestamps, muxed with the captured destination WAV at the AudioContext output timestamp. No source-file substitution, synthetic voice, dubbing, frame interpolation, or playback-rate change.

destinationRecording.gapScope: Delivered WAV and raw PCM contain exactly the chronologically observed AudioWorklet output blocks, without interpolation or inserted samples. Virtual currentFrame repeats/jumps are retained separately. Full decoded voice-buffer comparison, rather than currentFrame monotonicity alone, establishes whether spoken samples were lost.
